files.description: Wiki page documenting the EHI export feature — contains setup instructions, single-patient and population export instructions with screenshots, and links to the SchemaSpy data dictionary

SchemaSpy 6.2.4 index page — main tables listing showing all 322 database tables in the EHI export, with table descriptions, row counts, column counts, and relationship counts. Primary documentation link.
Backup copy of the SchemaSpy index page from alternate host. Content is identical to the primary link (confirmed via md5sum).

Machine-readable SchemaSpy XML schema — the primary computable artifact. Contains all 322 tables with 4,941 columns, data types, sizes, nullability, default values, 892 foreign key relationships, indexes, primary keys, and table/column remarks. This is the authoritative data dictionary.
SchemaSpy all-columns page — lists every column across all 322 tables with types, nullability, defaults, and comments. Rendered via JavaScript/DataTables.
SchemaSpy relationships page — visual diagram of table relationships (rendered client-side via JavaScript).
Table insertion order — lists all 322 tables in dependency order for database loading. Tables with no foreign key dependencies come first.
Table deletion order — reverse of insertion order, for safe removal respecting foreign key constraints.

318 individual SchemaSpy table documentation HTML pages. Each page documents a single table with column names, types, sizes, nullability, defaults, foreign key relationships, indexes, and descriptive comments. Downloaded in parallel via xargs.
files.curl_command: cat table-pages.txt | sed 's|^tables/||' | xargs -P 20 -I {} curl -sL 'https://seven.openemr.io/d/openemr/Documentation/EHI_Export/docs/tables/{}' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0' -o 'tables/{}'

files.description: Screenshot from wiki page showing the single patient EHI export interface — text field for patient PID, zip size limit, document inclusion checkbox, and export button.
Screenshot from wiki page showing the entire patient population export interface — same controls as single patient but with blank PID field and batch size configuration.
Screenshot from wiki page showing a completed export task with download link and hash verification value.
Browser screenshot of the SchemaSpy index page showing the rendered table listing with DataTables interface.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script — parses the SchemaSpy XML into queryable JSON. Extracts all 322 tables, 4,941 columns, foreign key relationships, indexes, and remarks.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script — extracts column-level comments from the 318 HTML table pages. Recovers 3,125 additional column descriptions not present in the XML.
Enrichment output — complete structured JSON schema with all 322 tables, 4,941 columns, types, relationships, indexes, and remarks. Primary queryable artifact for downstream analysis.
Enrichment output — parsing accounting for XML extraction (322 tables, 4,941 columns, 0 failures).
Enrichment output — column comments extracted from HTML table pages. 318 tables, 4,489 columns, 4,469 with comments.
Enrichment output — parsing accounting for HTML extraction (318 files, 0 failures).
Enrichment README — run commands, input boundaries, output descriptions, and known parsing limitations.
